notes:
Includes everything in 0.13.0, which was never published because the CI
signing secret was not set.

### Added
- Favorites: "Add to favorites" in a card's menu. Favorites are listed at
  the top of the sidebar; click one to place it.
- Search history: the last 15 searches appear under the search box.
- Automatic updates: new signed versions install without asking (on by
  default; toggle in Extensions > SU Model Library > Install Updates
  Automatically). Restart SketchUp to use the new version.

### Changed
- Wider model cards (160 px minimum) so previews no longer overlap.
